verdict.rationale: Resend documents a batch email endpoint (POST /emails/batch) that sends up to 100 messages per request. It also offers broadcasts that send to whole segments or audiences, and idempotency keys make bulk retries safe. Together these cover the core of bulk operations for email sending. missing for 10: bulk operations on non-email resources (e.g. bulk contact import, update or delete, bulk suppression management), batches beyond the 100-message cap, and independent hands-on corroboration of batch usage.
